identity: Extends existing OCB / Root7 book and 5B view lenses; no new canonical identity or graph relation.

visualReferences.role: Owner grayscale-to-spectrum display reference only; image not copied.
Owner Light Organ / Grey Space / retained trace reference only; no physical light or channel-constant claim.

streams: book: actual wingSequence.facets/cuts via existing Q4 render
5b: actual synthetic pose via cloned onRender callback, including player frames
stack: layered-pentagon scene with common phase, reused H3 geometry, separate retained stream; see a0-layered-pentagon-scene-v1.json
contract.history: 64 latest visited snapshots per source since page load, consecutive identical snapshots deduplicated; no old-chat import, no reconstruction of unvisited frames; discarded count visible; local clear retains current pose.
contract.projection: Book shadow: model point [x,y,z] -> [x,y,0] -> original W.pose(turn,tilt). 5B shadow: reuses exact source-computed shadow coordinates including reflection. Echo retains old screen-frame projections; no physical illumination.
contract.colours: Red/blue book channel = source left/right; 5B = 1/3 versus 2/4. Spectrum = four facet colours and three cut colours, fixed source order.
contract.greyshift: g=(R+G+B)/3 on 8-bit display channels; output round(g+a*(channel-g)), a in [0,1]. Colour display transform only, not physical luminance, wavelength, additive-light law, or geometric equality.
layers: visited-pose echo plus historical shadow/cuts when enabled
contract.clock: No overlay timer, source writes, network or cross-window commands. Book, 5B and layered scene clocks feed passive updates. The layered scene itself has an explicitly local view player; it does not command the native Blue/Pink runtime.
contract.export: Selected source current snapshot, retained history, dropped count, settings and boundaries in a0-projection-overlay.json; replay drawing from exported geometry.
contract.invalid: HOLD hides geometry for invalid source; successful new source read recovers.

openBoundaries: No 60-face Blue/Pink/Dodeca runtime binding introduced; central stack geometry is a direct reuse of the H3 geometry factory, not a remote native face operator
No AM/VM/PM or M/LRRL canonical vocabulary binding
Other attached spiral/prime formulas, numbers 42–47, resonances and physics are not executed or adopted

localPinReconciliation.reason: Host overlay UI, passive Root7 read hook, and optional cloned 5B observer callback. Only local implementation pins updated; no scientific or canonical baseline repaired.
